description: Get latest weather observation from the nearest ASOS/AWOS station to a US location. Returns current temperature (°C/°F), humidity, wind, pressure, visibility, dewpoint, heat index, wind chill. Powered by NOAA National Weather Service. US contiguous only.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (US contiguous only: 24–50)

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (US contiguous only: −125 to −66)

name: noaa.weather.observation

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NOAA Latest Observation (US)
